outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of micrograph images (pseudocoloured confocal frames), not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows normalized intensity vs. time as scatter/line-style plots where each individual measured data point (red squares for euchromatin, green triangles for heterochromatin) is directly plotted alongside the fitted model curves. This is a line/scatter plot type, which is exempt from requiring additional overlay, and individual data points are already explicitly displayed rather than only averages/fits.
